entities.name: Damia, Sage of Stone
entities.description: A sage who answers queries; one should not look her in the eye.

entities.name: Kaalia of the Vast
entities.description: A figure seeking revenge by calling on forces from above and below.

entities.name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
entities.description: A chieftain who returned from death as king of a greater realm.

entities.name: Ruhan of the Fomori
entities.description: A warrior unfettered by allegiance and driven by war.

entities.name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
entities.description: A reckoner of souls whom the dead may face after death, according to a priest's teaching.
